summary.text:
LG INR21700 M50, discharge 1.5C 0%-100%, ambient 25 degC
Limits: T_peak <= 45 degC, in-cell dT <= 5 degC, ready again within 180 min
39 designs, 0 feasible, 0 on the trade-off front
NOTE: bottom plates are solved in 2D (radius x height). A chiller pulling a hot-soaked pack down through its base opens large top-to-bottom gradients while it does so.
NOTE: liquid pump power covers the whole loop (4.7 mW/cell at most) and the radiator fan is charged at 3 % of the heat it rejects; chiller idle losses are not included.
No feasible design. Coolest: ribbon 0.05 g/s, chiller 15 °C, 3.5 mm gap, RT31-EG at 36.7 degC (fails: uneven). Reduce the load, raise the limits, or add stronger cooling.
